messages.subject: AIC and BIC is not produced
parts:
Hi,

I have a binary categorical exogenous variable- medical history that I have used fixed.x=TRUE to treat it as a covariate. I am not getting the Loglikelihood and Information Criteria as well as the AIC and BIC. I need the AIC and BIC to compare models. Please advise. 

Best,
Madeline

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: AIC and BIC is not produced
parts: I have a binary categorical exogenous variable- medical history that I have used fixed.x=TRUE to treat it as a covariate. I am not getting the Loglikelihood and Information Criteria as well as the AIC and BIC. I need the AIC and BIC to compare models. Please advise.

There's not much we can say with so little information.  Try posting your syntax and output, and tell us a little about your data.  Exogenous variables don't matter, but if you have categorical endogenous variables, lavaan will use DWLS estimation rather than ML.  Information criteria are calculated from log-likelihoods, which are only available using likelihood-based estimation, not least-squares estimators.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
